description: This file contains service functions for managing 'Tool' entities, including create, delete, retrieve, update, and import operations, utilizing TypeORM and Express app context.

methods.name: createTool
methods.description: Creates a new Tool entity, saves it to the database, and sends telemetry data.

methods.name: deleteTool
methods.description: Deletes a Tool entity by ID and workspace ID.

methods.name: getAllTools
methods.description: Retrieves all tools, optionally paginated and filtered by workspace ID.

methods.name: getToolById
methods.description: Fetches a Tool by its ID and workspace ID, throws error if not found.

methods.name: updateTool
methods.description: Updates an existing Tool entity with new data.

methods.name: importTools
methods.description: Imports multiple tools, handling ID validation, duplicates, and batch insertion.
